links.outcome: Rate of prediction withheld by gating engine for missing, implausible, or conflicting inputs in simulated workflow
links.effect: Schema-conforming extraction succeeded in 95% of inputs; prediction was withheld in 20% due to missing, implausible, or conflicting information.
links.quote: In simulated workflow testing, schema-conforming extraction succeeded in 95% of inputs, while prediction was withheld in 20% because of missing, implausible, or conflicting information.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI system incorporating deterministic safety-gating (readiness, plausibility, and consistency checks) that abstains from prediction when clinical input data are deficient.

primary.practice: safety-gating and abstention for data quality
